description:
Update the 'admin' user profile in JFrog Artifactory. 
1. Change the admin email address to 'admin@example.com'.
2. Retrieve the admin's 'Encrypted Password' (a security token used for Maven/Gradle clients) and save it to a text file at '/home/ga/encrypted_password.txt'.

Login credentials:
- URL: http://localhost:8082
- Username: admin
- Password: password

Navigation Hint: Look for the user profile/settings in the top-right corner of the UI (User Menu > Edit Profile). You may need to unlock the profile with your password to see the encrypted password.
